## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Amnéville, France. It starts at 1 Rue du Tigre.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> As far as zoos go, Amnéville is somewhat unique. Private and independent, it receives no subsidies, and you get that personal feel while exploring its 45-acre animal kingdom.
>
> With as many as 2,000 animals and plenty of eye-popping shows, a trip to Grand Est's wildlife hub is a journey to one of France’s most biodiverse locations and an ideal excursion for animal watching with the family.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €60.60. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 435 ratings and 174 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
